reconciliation: No source change was made. source/subscriptions.html:173-199 already states that FHIRcast synchronizes current context, sends single-event notifications, uses short-lived sessions, broadcasts the same notification concurrently, and optimizes for speed, while Subscriptions support distinct systems, batching, long-lived resources, and client-specific notification contents.
